content.user_title: Plan a Compliant Data Circulation Institution
content.value_statement: Organizations may struggle to choose a role and prepare credentials in the data circulation ecosystem. This skill creates structured positioning, qualification, compliance, and service-design guidance.
actual_capabilities: Compare data exchange, circulation platform, and data service provider roles.
Create a staged qualification roadmap based on organizational goals.
List evidence categories for data service provider certification and exchange membership applications.
Outline compliance controls for due diligence, review, recordkeeping, and internal audit.
Design standardized service offerings with deliverables, pricing inputs, and delivery stages.
Prepare a checklist for policy support applications and ongoing credential maintenance.
limitations: Does not verify current laws, exchange rules, or government programs.
Does not provide legal opinions or replace licensed professionals or regulators.
Cannot submit applications, obtain certificates, or guarantee approval.
Uses general guidance and needs local, current source validation.

use_cases.title: Choose an ecosystem role
use_cases.description: Compare organizational resources and select a suitable role in the data circulation ecosystem.

use_cases.title: Plan credential acquisition
use_cases.description: Build a phased plan for certifications, memberships, and supporting evidence.

use_cases.title: Productize advisory services
use_cases.description: Define standardized data circulation services, deliverables, and operational controls.

prompt_templates.title: Start a role assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether our company should pursue a data exchange role, a platform role, or a data service provider role. Ask for missing facts first.

prompt_templates.title: Build a qualification roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased qualification roadmap for a data service provider. Separate required items, optional items, evidence, owners, and review dates.

prompt_templates.title: Design compliance controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a compliance control checklist for data circulation services. Cover due diligence, authorization, review, recordkeeping, audit, and escalation.

prompt_templates.title: Create an operating plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day operating plan for entering a regional data circulation ecosystem. Include assumptions, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Help us decide how to enter the data circulation ecosystem.
output: Reason: it usually has lower infrastructure and regulatory requirements than operating an exchange.
Next step: validate local entry rules and prepare capability evidence.

output_examples.input: What should our membership application plan include?
output: Phase 1: confirm the target exchange and current eligibility rules.
Phase 2: collect corporate, capability, compliance, and case-study evidence.
Phase 3: submit through the official process and track review requests.

best_practices: Verify every policy, certification rule, and deadline through an official current source.
Keep an evidence register with owners, validity dates, and approval records.
Engage qualified legal and compliance professionals before filing or providing regulated services.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the skill output as a legal opinion or regulator approval.
Do not claim certification eligibility before checking the target organization’s current rules.
Do not use customer data or confidential application materials without documented authorization.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps plan institutional positioning, qualification work, compliance controls, and service offerings.

faq.question: Can it confirm current regulations?
faq.answer: No. Verify current rules with official sources and qualified local professionals.

faq.question: Can it submit an application?
faq.answer: No. It can organize a checklist and draft materials, but it cannot submit or approve applications.

faq.question: Does it guarantee certification?
faq.answer: No. Certification and membership decisions belong to the relevant organization or authority.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Strategy, operations, compliance, and data services teams considering data circulation activities.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your location, target role, existing credentials, capabilities, data types, and planned services.
